parameters.description: Per-myCAF contribution to cancer C_max. myCAFs build PDAC desmoplasia (collagen/CXCL12/VEGF) — dominant structural CAF subtype (Elyada 2019; Dominguez 2020).

parameters.name: k_stroma_iCAF
parameters.description: Per-iCAF contribution to cancer C_max. iCAFs are inflammatory secretors (IL-6/CXCL12), low αSMA, located distally from tumor — minimal structural carrying-capacity role (Elyada 2019, Öhlund 2017).

parameters.name: k_stroma_apCAF
parameters.description: Per-apCAF contribution to cancer C_max. apCAFs are rare (<5% of CAFs) MHC-II+ tolerogenic antigen-presenters — predominantly immunomodulatory (induce Treg expansion in antigen-specific manner), not structural (Elyada 2019, Huang 2022 Cancer Cell).

parameters.name: C_cap0
parameters.description: Baseline C-independent carrying-capacity floor (cells): parenchymal volume the lesion occupies pre-desmoplasia. UN-ANCHORED fitted structural handle (derivedFrom={}); value 1.7e9 is calibrated as the tumor_fold handle coupled with k_C1_growth~0.008, NOT a literature value. Candidate future submodel anchor: accessible parenchymal/lobular volume / vol_cell (queued in reconciliation_targets.csv) -- but GitHub #229 (V_T<->C_max unification) would DERIVE and dissolve it. Default 0 recovers prior stroma+vascular-only C_max exactly.

Anchored to f*k_CD8_T_pro (f~0.6): the vaccine-differential increment is a bounded fraction of the Blessin-anchored constitutive in-situ rate (k_CD8_T_pro=0.079/day). H_P1_spread-gated (zero without vaccine), saturating in V_T.CD8 density. Retained in gvax_module after the C13 TLA/urelumab cut. Prior sigma 0.7 (was 1.5 placeholder).
